newsitem.title: UK: BSkyB gets rugby union European Cup rights.
newsitem.headline: BSkyB gets rugby union European Cup rights.

text.p: British Sky Broadcasting Group Plc said on Friday it had secured the rights to broadcast rugby union's European Cup for the next five years.
BSkyB, partly owned by Rupert Murdoch's News Corp Ltd, said the agreement covered each competition from 1997-98 until the close of 2001/02.
"Rugby union in the UK has developed rapidly and interest in club ruby has never been higher," Sky TV said in a statement.
"The tournament will give the club game a brand new impetus and our subscribers the best rugby coverage," it added.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
